text:
Game Boy Classics – October 2026 – Games Update
Three classic Game Boy titles will be released on Game Boy – Nintendo Classics!

Avenging Spirit
This classic action game features a unique gameplay system where you possess and control other characters!

While out on a walk with his girlfriend, the daughter of a prestigious scientist, our hero is gunned down by an evil syndicate. Their goal is to harness ghost energy, and they plan on ransoming the poor girl to force her father into helping them. But our hero's adventure isn't over. In fact, it's just beginning! He's come back as a ghost so that he can rescue his girlfriend from her kidnappers and finally rest in peace! Who ever said love was easy? Throughout six fun and exciting stages, help reunite the protagonist with his beloved. Watch the moving ending as this hero's quest for revenge is finally put to rest!

Mole Mania™
Join Muddy Mole in a race to defeat the evil farmer, Jinbe!

Work your way through each puzzle by pushing, pulling, or throwing black balls to defeat or trap enemies. Blast strategic exits and burrow into soft soil to tunnel your way through underground paths to the next action-packed level. Defeat the bosses and solve all of the puzzles in Jinbe Land to reunite Muddy Mole with his beloved wife and kids. In the two-player VS Mode, you'll play two rounds, one attacking as Muddy and one defending as Jinbe, to compete based on the number of
cabbages dropped. You'll dig the fast pace and challenging fun of Mole Mania!

Revenge of the ‘Gator

Revenge of the 'Gator is a game in which you hit a falling ball with flippers to score points by aiming at targets and shooting the ball through lanes. Play across four main and three bonus stages, where each stage will have its own unique objective to complete. Start with three balls, and work your way up. But if your ball falls all the way down to the Gator Stage, it'll be the end of that turn. Lose all of the balls, and it's game over! Play solo in Gator 1Player mode, and try for a spot in the top five highest scores! You can also play with a friend in Gator 2Players or Match Play mode!
